posts.title: Using agents to fix Xbox cloud stream issues
posts.description: I’ve been an avid user of xbox cloud streaming, the service was initially flawless on my Aussie HFC connection, but I noticed that in every game session the stream would freeze and pause for up to 20s before suddenly snapping back to streaming fine.
